# Meridian Bay Legal Consultants

> Fictional firm. Meridian Bay Legal Consultants is not a real company: this is a demo landing page made for a web design test, and it does not offer legal services. The page presents a rental-dispute law firm in Dubai that represents tenants and landlords at the Rental Dispute Settlement Centre, in Arabic and English.

Canonical page: https://meridian-bay.example/

## Situations covered

- You received an eviction notice: We check whether the notice is valid before you agree to move out.
- Your tenant stopped paying rent: We file the claim and pursue payment and, if needed, eviction.
- Your deposit was not returned: We recover your security deposit and any deductions made without proof.
- Your rent was raised unfairly: We check the increase against the official rental index and challenge it if it is too high.

## How it works

1. Free case review: Send us your contract and any notices. Within 24 hours we tell you where you stand.
2. Fixed-fee quote: One price for the whole case. No hourly billing, no surprises.
3. We represent you: We prepare your file, submit it and attend every hearing on your behalf.

## Questions we hear often

- How much does a rental dispute case cost? We give you a fixed fee after the free review. The official filing fee comes on top, and we explain it upfront.
- How long does a case take? Most of our cases close within two to three months.
- Do I need to attend the hearings? No. With a power of attorney, we attend on your behalf.
- Do you work with both tenants and landlords? Yes, but never for both sides of the same dispute.
